summary.text: Kevin Corbin is a Republican member of the North Carolina State Senate who has represented District 50 since January 2021 and is on the ballot for re-election on November 3, 2026.
A business owner, he previously served in the North Carolina House of Representatives.

paragraphs.text: Kevin Corbin graduated from Franklin High School in 1979 and earned a bachelor's degree in business administration from Appalachian State University in 1983, according to Ballotpedia.
His career experience includes working as news editor of the Appalachian State University newspaper and owning The Corbin Agency and Blue Ridge Insurance Group.
Corbin represented North Carolina House District 120 from 2017 to 2021 and assumed office in the State Senate on January 1, 2021, succeeding Jim Davis.

For 2025-2026, Ballotpedia lists him as chair of the Appropriations on Education/Higher Education and Education/Higher Education committees and as a member of committees including Appropriations on Health and Human Services, Appropriations/Base Budget, Commerce and Insurance, Health Care, State and Local Government, and Pensions and Retirement and Aging.
